headline.title: OpenAI bets on families as ChatGPT goes deeper into households
headline.summary: OpenAI is seeking a product manager to develop ChatGPT experiences tailored for families, caregivers, and older adults, as indicated by a recent job posting. This move reflects the company's strategy to expand its AI offerings into household environments.

articles.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
articles.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, claiming that former Apple employees at the AI startup stole trade secrets related to hardware development. The lawsuit also includes IO Products, the hardware company founded by Jony Ive, as a defendant.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Head of Safety Is Leaving the Company
articles.summary: OpenAI's Head of Safety, Johannes Heidecke, is leaving the company amid efforts to better integrate its research and safety teams. His departure marks a significant change as OpenAI continues to focus on enhancing its safety protocols.

articles.title: Infinity-Parser2 Technical Report
articles.summary: Infinity-Parser2 is a new large multimodal model designed for end-to-end document parsing, which integrates a controllable data-synthesis pipeline with multi-task reinforcement learning. The model aims to address the lack of accurately annotated parsing corpora by utilizing a scalable synthesis engine and an iterative refinement process.

articles.title: Different Teachers, Different Capabilities: Sub-1B On-Device Distillation for Structured Text Enrichment
articles.summary: The article discusses a method for on-device distillation of structured text extraction, reducing the size of a large 8B model to a smaller 0.6B model while maintaining comparable output quality. The study evaluates the performance of this distilled model across various sub-tasks, demonstrating its efficiency in generating JSON objects with summaries and categorical labels.

articles.title: Applying JEPA-Style Predictive Learning to JA4-Derived Network Fingerprints
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a Transformer-based model called JA4-JEPA, which applies JEPA-style predictive learning to compact network fingerprints derived from JA4 subfields. The model is trained on approximately 397,000 samples from JA4DB and CIC-IDS-2017 datasets to assess the effectiveness of this approach in network analysis.

articles.title: DreamCharacter-1: From 3D Generative Foundation Models to Product-Ready Character Generation
articles.summary: DreamCharacter-1 is a new framework designed to refine pretrained 3D foundation models for high-quality character generation, featuring enhancements in geometry and texture. The system includes three components focused on optimizing surface details and synthesizing high-resolution textures to produce production-ready 3D characters.

articles.title: 3100 Opinions on Code Review in an AI World: Building Causal Theory from Practitioner Discourse
articles.summary: The article examines the impact of AI coding agents on code review practices, highlighting a divide among practitioners regarding the necessity of human review and the potential erosion of understanding in the process. It critiques existing repository-mining studies for their lack of depth in explaining the underlying mechanisms of observed trends in code review dynamics.

articles.title: SpO$_2$ Predictor-Guided Stage-Wise Time-Frequency Reconstruction of Low-Quality Dual-Wavelength PPG for Oxygen Saturation Estimation
articles.summary: The article presents a novel method for estimating oxygen saturation (SpO$_2$) from low-quality dual-wavelength photoplethysmography (PPG) signals using a stage-wise time-frequency reconstruction approach. This technique aims to improve SpO$_2$ prediction accuracy by addressing the limitations of existing denoising methods that focus primarily on waveform fidelity or heart rate characteristics.

articles.title: PS4: Proxy-Supervised Joint Training for Real Target Speaker Extraction
articles.summary: The article introduces PS4, a proxy-supervised training framework designed to enhance target speaker extraction (TSE) in real conversational mixtures, addressing the challenges posed by the lack of large-scale training data and clean target speech. The framework is built on a large-scale corpus of 71,771 training samples sourced from four public datasets, incorporating both Chinese and English languages.

articles.title: ICDAR 2026 HIPE-OCRepair Competition on LLM-Assisted OCR Post-Correction for Historical Documents
articles.summary: The ICDAR 2026 HIPE-OCRepair competition focused on leveraging large language models (LLMs) for OCR post-correction of historical documents, addressing the persistent issue of legacy OCR errors in digitized collections. The competition highlights the potential of LLMs to improve accuracy in the transcription of historical texts without the need for extensive re-digitization efforts.

articles.title: DrugGen 2: A disease-aware language model for enhancing drug discovery
articles.summary: DrugGen-2 is a new generative model designed to enhance drug discovery by creating small molecules based on both disease context and target protein sequences. This approach aims to improve therapeutic outcomes by integrating disease ontology into the drug design process, addressing limitations of current computational methods.
